summary: Five documents the research tools could not reach were retrieved and read against their text layers: the DHS memorandum of 2025-01-20 on enforcement actions in or near protected areas (1 page, official host; checked against the court exhibit copy in Mennonite Church USA v. DHS); the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness memorandum of 2025-02-03 on non-covered assisted reproductive technology (8 pages, Internet Archive snapshot of 2025-09-05 of the official address); section 1 FAM 134 of the Foreign Affairs Manual on the Office of China Coordination (web page, names no person; 24 searches found no state.gov page naming a coordinator in 2025 or 2026); the D.C. Circuit's per curiam order of 2026-07-17 in Make the Road New York v. Mullin, No. 25-5320 (1 page, RECAP copy of the filed order; no court-hosted copy exists in the public indexes and no disposition of the 2026-07-27 en banc petition was found); and the D.C. Circuit's order of 2026-08-05 in LeBlanc v. PCLOB, No. 25-5197 (2 pages, a Wolters Kluwer CCH copy of the filed order). Two independent reviewers rewrote the five records from the documents. c05-16 rose from 80 to 81 (the memorandum names no categories of protected location; the categories are now attributed to the 2021 guidelines and the ICE memorandum of 2025-01-31); c04-15 from 79 to 80 and c05-04 from 75 to 80, each entering the high band at its floor under the host rulings of 2026-10-26; c06-11 held at 62 with an unverified lead that the coordinator may have changed in October 2026; c07-06 held at 60, and its text no longer carries the 2026-11-17 argument date or the Trump v. Slaughter link, neither of which is in the order. No stage or progress changed.
